authority: Repository implementation and executable synthetic regression only
defect: Mean/std were fitted on all rows before the game split, allowing validation observations into training preprocessing. A single-game dataset also produced an empty training partition.
fix: Split games first, fit mean/std on training indices only, apply the frozen scaler to all rows, require at least two admitted games in Train/Verify, and save normalization version and split IDs in model metadata.

worker.verification: Primary verified every source hash/line count and every literal line citation; worker only inventoried old source.

validation_environment.source: Clean HEAD src/BotSim/NNTrain snapshot plus two scoped files; unrelated dirty probe changes excluded.
validation_environment.runtime_data_note: Exact runtime bytes match native-default proof; LF-normalized content matches HEAD. Matrix uses Git blob bytes separately.

remaining: Software training preprocessing contract only; no card/native rule certification or strength claim.
Existing model files retain their original normalization; retraining is required to apply this fix.
Group split algorithm is unchanged; without split-seed, repeated train/verify can choose different games. Metadata records IDs but Verify still reconstructs its split from the supplied seed.
Synthetic two-game pair cases have no opposite-label training pairs; they test preprocessing isolation, not pair-learning efficacy.
This closes direct scaler leakage only; repeated human model selection on validation metrics is outside this fix.
